text:
Alex: Quick sync — Q4 Optimize toolkit scope. Need final priors on batching/caching recommendations, regression gating, and canonical prompt sets. Two customer escalations to weigh in: Acme needs a hard 150ms median tail for chat completions; FinCorp is worried about quantization regressions after moving to int8. Can we align on MUST vs NICE?
Mira: +1. My take: prioritize caching + KV prefix reuse as MUST for latency and cost wins. Batching improvements are NICE-to-have but need infra work.
Sam: For regressions we need an automatic eval gate. Proposal: golden prompt set + aggregated metric alert (delta > 1.5% on quality score) triggers rollout rollback. Keeps rollout safe without manual checks.
Taylor: Re: OKRs — we committed to "Reduce inference cost/unit by 20%" and "Regressions <=1% on critical evals". So Sam's 1.5% is a bit loose. Can we tighten to 1% with fallback plan?
Sam: We can aim for 1% but that means slower rollout cadence and more pre-merge evals. Also need labelled prompt sets for each customer class (conversational, rerank, emb).
Zhang: Implementation notes: caching change needs a routing flag + placement in runtime config. Quick config draft: ```
# runtime caching config
cache:
  enabled: true
  mode: prefix_kv
  ttl_ms: 60000
  scope: customer|global
```
This would give Acme their median tail improvement if we enable prefix_kv and short ttl.
Priya: Testing capacity note — if we add pre-merge evals for every rollout, CI time grows ~3x. We can optimize by doing a sampled full-suite and smoke checks for minor changes. Also we need representative prompt sets from Acme/FinCorp.
Alex: Good call. For prioritization: MUST = caching (prefix_kv + customer scoping), auto-regression gate at 1% for critical evals, and canonical prompt sets for QA. NICE = advanced batching heuristics, quantization auto-tuning. Thoughts?
Mira: Agree. One caveat — customer scoping requires access controls for private deployments. That pushes some work into Private infra. Flagging eng-platform.
Taylor: We should list launch criteria in the spec doc: 1) latency target met on Acme simulation, 2) regression gate green for 3 consecutive runs, 3) prompt sets uploaded and verified, 4) rollout plan with canary + automatic rollback. If all true => GA.
Sam: I'll own the eval gate infra and golden prompt versioning. Need signal names: quality_score, latency_p50, latency_p95, cost_per_token.
Zhang: I'll prototype the runtime config toggle and add a compatibility shim for older models. ETA for prototype: 2 weeks.
Priya: I'll coordinate with Acme/FinCorp SEs for prompt sets and build the CI sampling strategy.
Alex: OK — action items: Sam: eval gate + metric thresholds (due EOD Fri). Zhang: runtime prototype (2w). Priya: collect prompt sets + CI plan (1w). Mira/Taylor: align on OKR tradeoffs and confirm MUST/NICE with infra. I'll update the spec doc after these inputs and share for sign-off. :thumbsup:
